definitions.explanation: Used with の to mark something as 'real', 'actual', or 'by blood'. Appears in a small set of common patterns including biological-family terms and rhetorical phrases that contrast the actual with the apparent.

examples.japanese: {実|じつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
{実|じつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{決|き}めていない→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: To tell the truth, I haven't decided yet.
She's my sister-in-law, not my biological sister.

notes:
Sino-Japanese reading of {実} meaning 'real' or 'actual'. Functions as a noun mainly in the fixed pattern {実|じつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (biological/real ~) and a few set phrases. The same kanji is also read み (fruit; substance) as a separate everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実|じつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧ / ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧ / ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧ / ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧: biological mother/father/brother/sister
- {実|じつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧: biological parent
- {実|じつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ / {実|じつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: to tell the truth
- {実|じつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧: actually; in fact
- {実|じつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: actually (sentence-initial)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧: real; true — the everyday equivalent
- ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧: reality — abstract; the real world as opposed to imagination
- ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧: the real thing — refers to objects, contrasted with fakes
